title: Tires Worth Gifting and Bragging About: Goodyear Has Something for Every Driver on Your List
summary: A tire for every driver on your list, including the sporty Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season to the hardworking Cooper Discoverer HT, all-weather Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2 to trail-ready Mickey...
body_markdown:
- *A tire for every driver on your list, including the sporty Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season to the hardworking Cooper Discoverer HT, all-weather Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2 to trail-ready Mickey Thompson Baja Boss A/T*
- *Installation and car care at Goodyear Auto Service and Just Tires stores or in your driveway with Goodyear Mobile Garage Service in 27 U.S. markets*
- *Goodyear gear for everyone on your list, from apparel and accessories to gifts for the family dog.*


AKRON, Ohio


, Nov. 11, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Snowy holidays sound magical and top many wish lists, but they also call for high-performing tires. Amid holiday traffic and weather, tires with serious grip, traction and braking help protect families on the road. Tires aren't a typical gift, and that's exactly what makes them memorable. For shoppers buying for an auto enthusiast, a daily commuter or a trail-bound adventurer, there's a Goodyear tire worth gifting and bragging about this holiday season.


**The Tire List: Four tires, four kinds of drivers.**
Every driver is different, which is why matching the tire to the driver is what matters most. Here are four tires worth gifting, from sport performance to trail-ready toughness.


**Eagle® F1 All Season: For the driver who lives for the fast lane** Some people drive because they have to. Others drive because they love it, and for them there's the Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season. It brings sport performance to year-round driving, with wet braking capability and reliable grip in light snow, so the fun doesn't have to hibernate when the temperature drops. Think of it as the gift for the weekend canyon-carver, the commuter who wants a little more fun in the daily drive, or anyone who thinks a drive should be about more than getting there.


It also comes with some serious history. The Eagle name has been about performance for more than 45 years. In 1992, McLaren launched the McLaren F1, then the world's fastest production car, with a Guinness World Record speed of 240.1 mph. Goodyear developed a special tire for it, the Eagle F1, and its directional tread pattern became the inspiration for the next generation of Eagle road tires.


That legacy is front and center again this year. In May, Goodyear launched[Fast Is In Us](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=3233847244&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.prnewswire.com%2Fnews-releases%2Fdid-someone-say-horsepower-goodyear-launches-global-campaign-celebrating-eagle-performance-tire-302760373.html&a=Fast+Is+In+Us) , a global campaign celebrating the Eagle performance tire family.[Watch the campaign](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=1025187360&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DrVEfIrR_we4&a=Watch+the+campaign) to see the Eagle legacy in action.


Shop the Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season in the[U.S.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=605815014&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Ftires%2Feagle-f1-all-season_25327%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agy%3Ana%3Aeagle%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=U.S.) or[Canada](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=2156670704&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-ca%2Ftires%2Feagle-f1-all-season_25327%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agyca%3Ana%3Aeagle%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Canada) .


**Cooper Discoverer® HT: For the driver who hauls, tows and carpools** For the toughest and most rugged, the all-new Cooper Discoverer HT is engineered for drivers who rely on their trucks and SUVs every day, whether for work, family or adventure. It's a great fit for the person with the always-packed pickup, the SUV that handles carpool, soccer and road trips, and anyone who tows more than they'd like to admit.


Available in both metric and LT fitments, it's designed to deliver a stable, confident ride, long-lasting durability and dependable performance under heavy loads. The tread pattern is optimized for even wear, and the construction is built for towing and hauling. The secret to staying power is its 3D Micro-Gauge™ sipes, tiny slits in the tread that create additional biting edges as the tire wears, so traction keeps showing up as the miles add up. It's backed by up to a 70,000-mile limited treadwear warranty.


Shop the Cooper Discoverer HT in the[U.S.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=940988866&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.coopertire.com%2Fen_US%2Ftires%2Fdiscoverer-ht%2F250105.html%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Act%3Ana%3Adiscoverer%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=U.S.) or[Canada](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=4023066315&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.coopertire.ca%2Fen_CA%2Ftires%2Fdiscoverer-ht%2F250105.html%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Actca%3Ana%3Adiscoverer%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Canada) .


**Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady® 2: For the driver ready for whatever the forecast brings** Heat, rain and snow each ask something different of a tire. For the practical four-season workhorse, the Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2 is built for all-weather driving. It features Goodyear's All-Weather Technology, with a versatile tread compound that adapts to any weather condition.


Its AquaTred Technology uses sweeping Evolving Traction Grooves to help move water and slush away from the tire. It also carries the Three-Peak Mountain Snowflake (3PMS) designation, which indicates the tire meets or surpasses stringent snow traction criteria. A built-in wear gauge lets drivers keep an eye on tread depth, and a 60-day satisfaction guarantee comes with it.


Shop the Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2 and find your fitment in the[U.S.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=2681105505&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-us%2Ftires%2Fassurance-weatherready-2_24987%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agy%3Ana%3Aweatherready2%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=U.S.) or[Canada](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=54157639&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fen-ca%2Ftires%2Fassurance-weatherready-2_24987%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agyca%3Ana%3Aweatherready2%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Canada) .


**Mickey Thompson Baja Boss® A/T: For the driver who sees a dirt road and takes it** Mickey Thompson's best-selling tire is made for people whose weekend plans include a trail. The Baja Boss A/T is a premium, extreme hybrid all-terrain tire designed to deliver strong on-road handling and tread wear, while still dominating in mud and snow. It's a gift that makes sense for the Jeep® owner, the truck guy with a trail map in the glovebox, and anyone whose idea of a scenic route doesn't have pavement.


The Baja Boss A/T has an asymmetric tread pattern optimized to reduce noise and balance off-road traction with on-road handling. A silica-reinforced compound helps with wet handling and braking, and the Extreme Sidebiters add traction and protection on LT sizes. LT sizes also feature PowerPly XD three-ply construction for added puncture resistance. Sizes 12.50 (315) and narrower carry the Three-Peak Mountain Snowflake symbol, which certifies them as severe snow rated, and the tire is backed by a treadwear warranty of up to 60,000 miles on SUV sizes and 50,000 miles on LT sizes.


Available in the U.S. and Canada,[see all Baja Boss A/T sizes and shop](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=1232241514&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mickeythompsontires.com%2Flight-truck-tires%2Fbaja-boss-a-t%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Amt%3Ana%3Abaja%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=see+all+Baja+Boss+A%2FT+sizes+and+shop) .


**How Do You Gift Tires?** Giving tires is easier than it sounds. Here's how to get it right:


1. **Start with the vehicle.** Tires are made for specific vehicles, so fit matters. The tire finder at[goodyear.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=2741056156&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2F%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agy%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=goodyear.com) lets shoppers search by vehicle, tire size, license plate or VIN.
2. **Keep driving style and where they drive top of mind.** Commuting, weather, hauling or performance? Match the tire to the driving, not just the car. The Goodyear team is available online or in-store to help narrow down the right fit.
3. **Pick the installation.** Professional installation is available at[Goodyear Auto Service](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=1247794333&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fgoodyearautoservice%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agas%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Goodyear+Auto+Service) and[Just Tires](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=3434643865&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.justtires.com%2F%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Ajt%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Just+Tires) stores, or at the driver's home, work or anywhere in between with[Goodyear Mobile Garage Service](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=3743832757&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fmobile-garage%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Amti%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Goodyear+Mobile+Garage+Service) *.


**Installation made easy: At the store or in the driveway** Installing new tires doesn't have to take over the day. Here's how each option works.


Goodyear Mobile Garage Service brings tire installation and select vehicle services to a driver's home, work or another approved location in 27 U.S. markets. The process is simple: choose tires or services online, schedule an appointment, clear a safe space, and a technician arrives. Drivers can check availability, shop for tires and schedule an appointment at[goodyear.com/mobile-garage](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=2097558396&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fmobile-garage%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Amti%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=goodyear.com%2Fmobile-garage) .


Goodyear's company-owned retail network of[Goodyear Auto Service](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=1247794333&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2Fgoodyearautoservice%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agas%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Goodyear+Auto+Service) and[Just Tires](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=3434643865&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.justtires.com%2F%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Ajt%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=Just+Tires) stores also make car care easy in one stop. Every store offers professional tire installation, plus alignments, oil changes, brakes and batteries. With any service, customers receive a complimentary Courtesy Tire & Maintenance Inspection, during which a technician checks tire pressure and tread depth, along with the vehicle's battery, brakes and accessible fluids.


The network keeps growing. Goodyear has more than 500 company-owned stores nationwide, with recent openings including the[Goodyear Motor City Garage in Detroit](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=3781771363&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.prnewswire.com%2Fnews-releases%2Fgoodyear-opens-goodyear-motor-city-garage-retail-concept-celebrates-2026-woodward-dream-cruise-with-rare-double-blimp-event-302841114.html&a=Goodyear+Motor+City+Garage+in+Detroit) , a first-of-its-kind Goodyear retail concept built for drivers and car enthusiasts. Appointments are easy to schedule at[goodyear.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820386-1&h=2741056156&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.goodyear.com%2F%3Fcmpid%3Dpr%3Ana%3Agy%3Ana%3Ana%3Ana%3Agiftguide2026&a=goodyear.com) or by calling the store nearest you.

Goodyear's merchandise mixes racing heritage, classic Americana style and blimp-inspired picks for everyone on your list.
